numeric.name: driver_age
numeric.description: Age of the primary driver in years; a core risk factor capturing young/inexperienced and elderly driver risk profiles.

numeric.name: vehicle_age
numeric.description: Age of the insured vehicle in years; older vehicles typically have lower values but higher mechanical failure risk and different repair cost profiles.
numeric.data_quality_note: Maximum of 68 years is unusually high; may indicate data entry errors or classic/vintage vehicles — consider capping or flagging extremes.

numeric.name: age_driving_licence
numeric.description: Number of years the driver has held a driving licence; proxy for driving experience independent of age.
numeric.data_quality_note: Minimum of 0 may indicate newly licensed drivers or data quality issues; verify consistency with driver_age.

numeric.name: vehicle_value
numeric.description: Market or insured value of the vehicle; key driver of property damage and theft premium adequacy.
numeric.data_quality_note: 0.14% nulls present; maximum of ~374k suggests high-value outliers — consider log transformation and capping.

numeric.name: power_to_weight_ratio
numeric.description: Vehicle power relative to weight; proxy for vehicle performance and associated accident severity risk.
numeric.data_quality_note: Minimum of 0 may indicate missing or erroneous entries; verify zero values represent valid low-power vehicles.

numeric.name: seats
numeric.description: Number of seats in the vehicle; relates to occupant exposure and vehicle category (passenger car vs. minibus).

numeric.name: liability_exposure
numeric.description: Fractional exposure period for liability coverage; captures partial-year policies and mid-term changes affecting premium.
numeric.data_quality_note: Minimum of 0.0027 suggests very short-term policies; verify alignment with total_exposure.

categorical.name: policy_type
categorical.description: Type of motor insurance policy (e.g., comprehensive, third-party); directly determines coverages included and expected premium level.

categorical.name: business_type
categorical.description: Indicates whether the policy is new business (NB) or a renewal/portfolio transfer (P); renewal business may reflect lower-risk retained customers.

categorical.name: payment_frequency
categorical.description: Frequency of premium payment (Annual, Semi-annual, Quarterly); may correlate with customer segment and lapse risk affecting exposure.

categorical.name: bonus_score
categorical.description: Bonus-malus or customer quality score (Good, Neutral, Bad); reflects historical claims behaviour and is a strong risk predictor.

categorical.name: fuel_type
categorical.description: Type of fuel used by the vehicle (Diesel or Gasoline); correlates with vehicle category, usage intensity, and repair costs.
categorical.data_quality_note: 0.36% nulls; small proportion but should be imputed or flagged as unknown category.

categorical.name: vehicle_brand
categorical.description: Manufacturer brand of the insured vehicle; captures brand-level differences in repair costs, theft attractiveness, and safety ratings.
categorical.data_quality_note: 68 unique brands with long tail of low-frequency brands; grouping by risk profile or volume is recommended.

categorical.name: municipality_type
categorical.description: Classification of the municipality where the vehicle is garaged (e.g., urban, rural, intermediate); captures geographic risk density.

categorical.name: circulation_area
categorical.description: Primary area of vehicle circulation (Urban or Rural); urban areas typically exhibit higher frequency of minor accidents and theft.
